title: T-Cell Lymphomas
subtitle: StewardMD ONCOTREE Navigator (NCCN Guidelines Version 1.2026)
provenanceNote: Comprehensive NCCN Guidelines Version 1.2026 clinical navigator for T-Cell Lymphomas. Covers complete clinical algorithm: Diagnostic Workup (excisional or incisional biopsy avoiding FNA alone, comprehensive IHC immunophenotyping with CD30 and EBER ISH, TCR gamma/beta clonality, targeted NGS profiling, FDG-PET/CT plus bilateral marrow staging, baseline echocardiogram before anthracyclines) -> Subtype and CD30 Expression Stratification (CD30-positive ALCL/CD30+ PTCL vs CD30-negative PTCL-NOS/AITL/TFH vs extranodal NK/T-cell nasal type vs relapsed or refractory) -> CD30-positive first-line BV-CHP per ECHELON-2 with consolidative ASCR in CR1 except low/intermediate-IPI ALK-positive ALCL -> CD30-negative first-line CHOEP (or CHOP) with consolidative ASCR in CR1 -> Localized NK/T-cell concurrent chemoradiotherapy or P-GEMOX and advanced SMILE or P-GEMOX with allogeneic HCT -> Relapsed or refractory brentuximab, HDAC inhibitor, or pralatrexate salvage to allogeneic HCT. References StewardMD Standard Protocols. DRAFT - clinical decision support; physician decides and dose engine calculates patient-specific doses.
sourceNote: Structured in accordance with NCCN Clinical Practice Guidelines in Oncology (NCCN Guidelines) for T-Cell Lymphomas Version 1.2026.

a.text: BV-CHP per ECHELON-2: brentuximab vedotin 1.8 mg/kg IV day 1 plus cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, and prednisone every 21 days for 6 cycles. Vincristine is omitted from the CHP backbone to avoid overlapping neurotoxicity with brentuximab vedotin.

b.text: Consolidative autologous stem cell rescue (ASCR) in first complete remission (CR1) is recommended for ALK-negative ALCL and CD30-positive or CD30-negative PTCL responders. ALK-positive ALCL with low or intermediate IPI achieves cure with BV-CHP alone without ASCR.

c.text: CHOEP adds etoposide 100 mg/m2 days 1-3 to CHOP for patients aged 60 years or younger with good performance status. CHOP is used for older or unfit patients. Give G-CSF primary prophylaxis for the etoposide-added febrile-neutropenia risk.

d.text: Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma is EBV-driven and resistant to anthracyclines through P-glycoprotein-mediated efflux. Localized disease receives concurrent chemoradiotherapy (radiotherapy 50 Gy or higher) or L-asparaginase regimens (P-GEMOX); advanced disease receives SMILE or P-GEMOX with allogeneic HCT for fit responders.

e.text: Relapsed or refractory salvage is selected by CD30 status and subtype biology: brentuximab vedotin for CD30-positive relapse, HDAC inhibitors (romidepsin or belinostat, preferred for AITL/TFH), or pralatrexate with vitamin B12 and folic acid. Consolidate second remission with allogeneic HCT in eligible candidates.

nodes.name: Diagnostic Workup
nodes.title: T-Cell Lymphomas: Diagnostic Workup Checklist
nodes.description: Step 1: Complete the clinical workup before subtype and CD30 expression stratification. Confirm tissue diagnosis with full immunophenotype and clonality, complete NGS profiling, stage with PET/CT and marrow, and record baseline cardiac function before anthracyclines.
bullets: Excisional or incisional surgical biopsy of enlarged lymph node or involved tissue for histopathology (avoid FNA alone, which is insufficient for T-cell lymphoma subtyping)
Comprehensive IHC immunophenotyping: CD3, CD4, CD8, CD30, CD2, CD5, CD7, CD10, BCL6, PD-1, CXCL13, ALK, CD56, cytotoxic markers (TIA-1, granzyme B), and EBER in situ hybridization
T-cell receptor (TCR) gamma/beta gene rearrangement analysis to confirm clonal T-cell population
Targeted NGS mutation profiling (RHOA, TET2, DNMT3A, IDH2, STAT3, STAT5B, and ALK fusions)
Staging: whole-body FDG-PET/CT (or contrast-enhanced CT) and bilateral bone marrow aspirate and biopsy
Baseline echocardiogram for left ventricular ejection fraction prior to anthracycline-based therapy

options.label: Workup Complete - Proceed to Subtype and CD30 Expression Stratification

nodes.name: Subtype and CD30 Expression Stratification
nodes.title: T-Cell Lymphomas: Subtype and CD30 Expression Stratification
nodes.description: Workup complete. Assign subtype and CD30 expression status plus presentation (frontline nodal vs extranodal NK/T vs relapsed); the group selects the BV-CHP, CHOEP, L-asparaginase, or salvage pathway.
nodes.path: T-Cell Lymphomas / Subtype and CD30 Expression Stratification
bullets: CD30-positive disease: systemic anaplastic large cell lymphoma (ALK-positive or ALK-negative), or CD30-positive PTCL-NOS or AITL with expression at 10 percent or higher.
CD30-negative peripheral T-cell lymphoma: PTCL-NOS, angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma (AITL), or T-follicular helper (TFH) phenotype without qualifying CD30 expression.
Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, nasal type: EBV-driven extranodal disease of the nasal cavity, nasopharynx, or other extranodal sites.
Relapsed or refractory disease: primary refractory T-cell lymphoma or any relapse after frontline therapy; CD30 status at relapse determines salvage selection before allogeneic HCT.

nodes.name: CD30-Positive Treatment
nodes.title: CD30-Positive Disease: BV-CHP With Consolidative ASCR in CR1
nodes.description: First-line BV-CHP per ECHELON-2 for CD30-positive systemic ALCL and CD30-positive PTCL; consolidative ASCR in CR1 for ALK-negative ALCL and CD30-positive PTCL, omitted for low or intermediate-IPI ALK-positive ALCL cured by BV-CHP alone.
bullets: First-line BV-CHP every 21 days x 6 cycles: Brentuximab vedotin 1.8 mg/kg IV day 1 + Cyclophosphamide 750 mg/m2 day 1 + Doxorubicin 50 mg/m2 day 1 + Prednisone 100 mg/day days 1-5 (ECHELON-2 trial).
Omit vincristine from the CHP backbone to avoid overlapping neurotoxicity with brentuximab vedotin; monitor for peripheral neuropathy and neutropenia with G-CSF support per febrile-neutropenia risk.
Consolidative Autologous Stem Cell Rescue (ASCR) in first complete remission (CR1) for ALK-negative ALCL and CD30-positive PTCL-NOS or AITL responders.
ALK-positive ALCL with low or intermediate IPI achieves cure with BV-CHP alone without ASCR; reserve transplant for high-risk or incomplete-response cases per multidisciplinary review.
Restage with FDG-PET/CT after 3-4 cycles and at end of treatment; offer clinical trial enrollment at every line.
Physician decides; dose engine calculates patient-specific doses.
nodes.regimenSummary: BV-CHP (Brentuximab vedotin + CHP) x 6 cycles +/- Consolidative ASCR in CR1

nodes.name: CD30-Negative Treatment
nodes.title: CD30-Negative PTCL: CHOEP Followed by Consolidative ASCR in CR1
nodes.description: First-line CHOEP (or CHOP for older or unfit patients) for CD30-negative PTCL-NOS, AITL, and TFH disease, followed by consolidative high-dose therapy and ASCR in CR1 for responding patients.
bullets: First-line CHOEP every 21 days x 6 cycles for patients aged 60 years or younger with good performance status: Cyclophosphamide 750 mg/m2 day 1 + Doxorubicin 50 mg/m2 day 1 + Vincristine 1.4 mg/m2 day 1 + Etoposide 100 mg/m2 days 1-3 + Prednisone 100 mg/day days 1-5; CHOP for older or unfit patients who cannot tolerate etoposide.
Give G-CSF primary prophylaxis given the etoposide-added febrile-neutropenia risk; monitor CBC before each cycle with tumor lysis prophylaxis for high tumor burden.
Consolidative High-Dose Therapy and Autologous Stem Cell Rescue (ASCR) in CR1 for responding patients proceeding to transplant evaluation.
Baseline and serial echocardiograms given cumulative anthracycline exposure; assess response with interim and end-of-treatment FDG-PET/CT.
Physician decides; dose engine calculates patient-specific doses.
nodes.regimenSummary: CHOEP (Cyclophosphamide/Dox/Vincristine/Etoposide/Pred) x 6 -> Consolidative ASCR in CR1

nodes.name: NK/T-Cell Treatment
nodes.title: Extranodal NK/T-Cell Lymphoma, Nasal Type: CCRT or L-Asparaginase Regimens
nodes.description: Stage-adapted therapy for EBV-driven extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma: concurrent chemoradiotherapy or P-GEMOX for localized disease, SMILE or P-GEMOX with allogeneic HCT for advanced disease.
bullets: Stage I/II (localized): concurrent chemoradiotherapy (CCRT: radiotherapy 50 Gy or higher + Cisplatin/Etoposide-based chemotherapy) or non-anthracycline L-asparaginase regimens (P-GEMOX: Gemcitabine + Oxaliplatin + Pegaspargase).
Stage III/IV (advanced): SMILE (Dexamethasone, Methotrexate, Ifosfamide, L-asparaginase, Etoposide) or P-GEMOX, selected by fitness, renal function, and prior exposure.
Anthracycline-based regimens are ineffective in NK/T-cell disease because of P-glycoprotein-mediated multidrug resistance; use L-asparaginase-containing therapy.
Consider Allogeneic HCT for fit patients with advanced-stage response or high-risk disease after L-asparaginase-based induction.
Monitor EBV DNA load, CBC, coagulation, pancreatitis, hepatotoxicity, and hypersensitivity on asparaginase; restage with FDG-PET/CT and EBV DNA.
Physician decides; dose engine calculates patient-specific doses.
nodes.regimenSummary: Concurrent ChemoRT (>=50 Gy) or P-GEMOX / SMILE (L-Asparaginase Regimens)

nodes.name: Relapsed or Refractory Treatment
nodes.title: Relapsed or Refractory Disease: Targeted and Epigenetic Salvage to Allogeneic HCT
nodes.description: Targeted second-line and epigenetic salvage selected by CD30 status and subtype biology, consolidated with allogeneic HCT in eligible candidates achieving second remission.
nodes.path: T-Cell Lymphomas / Relapsed or Refractory / Treatment
bullets: Brentuximab vedotin 1.8 mg/kg IV every 3 weeks for CD30-positive relapses, with peripheral neuropathy and neutropenia monitoring.
HDAC inhibitors for epigenetic salvage, preferred for AITL/TFH biology: Romidepsin 14 mg/m2 on days 1, 8, and 15 every 28 days, or Belinostat per labeling with CBC and ECG monitoring.
Pralatrexate 30 mg/m2 weekly for 6 of 7 weeks with vitamin B12 and folic acid supplementation and mucositis monitoring.
Consolidate second remission with Allogeneic Hematopoietic Cell Transplantation (HCT) for eligible candidates; enroll in a clinical trial wherever available.
Re-biopsy at relapse to confirm histology and CD30 status; restage with FDG-PET/CT and bone marrow assessment as indicated.
Physician decides; dose engine calculates patient-specific doses.
nodes.regimenSummary: Targeted Epigenetic Salvage (Brentuximab / Romidepsin / Pralatrexate) -> Allogeneic HCT
